clinical_validation: Unvalidated research prototype; educational symptom-feature matching only

care_options.name: Appropriate rest, regular meals and fluid intake, and reduction of known triggers
care_options.eligibility: After assessing red flags and the suitability of the fluid plan.
care_options.cautions: Must not delay triage of a new or worsening headache; review fluid restrictions.

care_options.name: Paracetamol after physician approval
care_options.eligibility: Assess allergies, the medication profile, and the administration record first.
care_options.cautions:
Previous allergy, liver or kidney disease, or low body weight requires review.
Prevent duplicate use of products containing the same active ingredient; suspected excess use requires immediate assessment.
Frequent use may worsen headache.

care_options.name: Ibuprofen if authorized by the physician
care_options.eligibility: Individual selection after reviewing risks and interactions.
care_options.cautions:
Allergy to aspirin/anti-inflammatory medicines, gastrointestinal ulceration or bleeding, or kidney/heart/liver disease.
Review asthma, clotting disorders, pregnancy, and anticoagulants.
Do not combine with another anti-inflammatory medicine; it does not treat an unresolved cause of headache.

care_options.name: Oral fluids as tolerated and a physician-reviewed hydration plan
care_options.eligibility: Alert and able to swallow and keep fluids down after triage.
care_options.cautions: Inability to drink or signs of deterioration require escalation; review fluid and electrolyte restrictions.

care_options.name: Reduce provocative visual stimuli and movement in accordance with mission safety
care_options.eligibility: A clear association reviewed by the physician.
care_options.cautions: Adapt to training and the mission plan; persistent symptoms require reassessment.

care_options.name: Promethazine for the space motion sickness candidate only, if approved by the physician
care_options.purpose: Relieve nausea and vomiting from possible space motion sickness
care_options.eligibility: Medical review, an approved plan, prior tolerance testing where available, and inventory verification; not an automatic treatment for all vomiting.
care_options.cautions:
Review angle-closure glaucoma, urinary retention, seizures, breathing difficulties, and heart, liver, and kidney disease.
Review sedatives, opioids, antidepressants, and antiarrhythmic medicines; possible drowsiness and impaired concentration matter for critical tasks.
Mention in previous missions does not establish availability or safety on Mars; do not encode invasive administration routes.

care_options.name: Reduce known exposure and use an approved nasal saline preparation
care_options.eligibility: After triage, using a preparation and administration method approved for the mission.
care_options.cautions: Does not replace the anaphylaxis pathway or assessment of breathlessness.

care_options.name: A physician-selected, less-sedating antihistamine, such as loratadine or fexofenadine
care_options.eligibility: Individual selection after reviewing allergies, the medication profile, and the available preparation.
care_options.cautions:
Review heart, liver, and kidney disease, epilepsy, and pregnancy; suitability differs by preparation.
Drowsiness can occur even with less-sedating types; review sedating medicines and duplicate antihistamine use.
Not a substitute for the anaphylaxis pathway.

care_options.name: Gradual adjustment of fiber, fluids, activity, and toilet routine
care_options.eligibility: After assessing signs of obstruction and the suitability of food and fluids.
care_options.cautions: Do not apply automatically with severe pain, vomiting, or inability to pass gas; fluid restrictions require review.

care_options.name: Bisacodyl if selected by the physician
care_options.purpose: Relieve constipation after assessing its cause
care_options.eligibility: After excluding red flags and determining the preparation's suitability within the plan.
care_options.cautions:
Dehydration, severe abdominal pain with nausea/vomiting, obstruction, or bowel inflammation requires withholding/review.
Review pregnancy; do not treat presumed impaction or a surgical cause without assessment.
Review diuretics, steroids, and digoxin because of electrolyte imbalance risk; antacids may affect the tablet coating, requiring a pharmacist-arranged schedule.

care_options.name: An approved oral rehydration solution selected by the physician
care_options.eligibility: Able to swallow and tolerate fluids without severe deterioration.
care_options.cautions:
Review diabetes, kidney disease, fluid/electrolyte restrictions, and the choice of preparation.
Failure of hydration or deterioration in consciousness requires escalation; do not prepare an improvised formulation.

care_options.name: Food as tolerated, hand hygiene, and food safety
care_options.purpose: Support recovery and reduce possible infection transmission
care_options.eligibility: According to the ability to eat and the mission nutrition plan.
care_options.cautions: Continuing restrictive diets require review; persistent symptoms require reassessment of the cause.

care_options.name: Loperamide only if authorized by the physician
care_options.eligibility: After reviewing the cause and excluding red flags.
care_options.cautions:
Do not use with severe diarrhea after antibiotics, a flare of bowel inflammation, constipation, or bloating.
Blood, fever, liver disease, or pregnancy requires review; do not delay infection assessment.
Including this option does not imply that an antibiotic is appropriate; the physician selects one only for certain causes.

care_options.name: Adjust meal size and avoid personal triggers and eating close to lying down
care_options.eligibility: After triage, with suitability for nutrition and the mission schedule.
care_options.cautions: Must not delay assessment of chest pain, swallowing difficulty, or bleeding; do not generalize terrestrial bed arrangements to Mars.

care_options.name: An antacid or alginate selected by the physician
care_options.eligibility: Select the preparation according to the person's profile and approved inventory.
care_options.cautions:
Review kidney and liver disease, heart failure, sodium restrictions, and pregnancy.
May affect absorption of other medications; an approved pharmacist-arranged schedule is required.
Frequent need or persistent symptoms requires assessment of the cause.

care_options.name: Omeprazole if authorized by the physician
care_options.eligibility: An option for medical review after assessing the cause and red flags; it must not be assumed to be added to existing acid-suppressing medication.
care_options.cautions:
May mask signs of serious disease; does not replace assessment of bleeding, weight loss, or swallowing difficulty.
Review liver and kidney status, osteoporosis, and interactions with clopidogrel, warfarin, and digoxin.

care_options.name: Famotidine as a physician-reviewed alternative when a proton pump inhibitor is unsuitable or the response is inadequate
care_options.purpose: Reduce acid as a possible alternative option
care_options.eligibility: An individual decision after reviewing the cause of symptoms and prior treatment; no automatic addition to omeprazole.
care_options.cautions:
Review of kidney function, allergies, and interactions is required, including some antifungals and HIV medicines.
Persistent symptoms, swallowing difficulty, or bleeding requires assessment of the cause; the list is not exhaustive.

care_options.name: Appropriate activity and task modification instead of bed rest
care_options.eligibility: After excluding red flags and reviewing mission constraints.
care_options.cautions: Major injury or a neurological deficit stops the routine care pathway.

care_options.name: An individualized movement and exercise program approved by a specialist
care_options.eligibility: After assessing ability and environmental constraints.
care_options.cautions: Worsening or new neurological symptoms requires stopping the provoking activity and assessment; no instruction in self-administered spinal manipulation.

care_options.name: Ibuprofen if the physician determines it is suitable
care_options.eligibility: Assess gastrointestinal, kidney, and heart risks and interactions first.
care_options.cautions:
Review ulceration/bleeding, allergy to anti-inflammatory medicines, asthma, pregnancy, and liver/kidney/heart disease.
Review anticoagulants and prevent combination with another anti-inflammatory medicine.
Paracetamol alone is not recommended for low back pain; the alternative is selected medically.

care_options.name: Bladder drainage by catheterization by an authorized specialist
care_options.eligibility: Acute retention assessed by a physician.
care_options.cautions: Requires competence, equipment, and an approved plan; no self-treatment steps for untrained personnel.

care_options.name: Review medication that may be causing retention
care_options.eligibility: After medication reconciliation and physician assessment.
care_options.cautions: Do not stop or adjust medication independently.

care_options.name: Bladder training plan and management of the chronic cause
care_options.purpose: Improve emptying in a stable condition
care_options.eligibility: Chronic retention after excluding an urgent need for drainage.
care_options.cautions:
Must not be used to delay drainage of acute retention.
A specialist determines whether the plan is suitable.

care_options.name: Tamsulosin option after assessment of the cause
care_options.purpose: Improve urine flow in selected causes
care_options.eligibility: Difficulty emptying associated with an enlarged prostate, assessed by a physician.
care_options.cautions:
Not suitable for every case of retention and must not delay drainage of acute retention.
Review orthostatic hypotension, fainting, kidney and liver status, allergies, eye surgery, and interactions.
Requires a medical decision, an approved plan, and verified inventory.

care_options.name: Rest and fluids appropriate to the condition
care_options.eligibility: Able to tolerate drinking, in accordance with the fluid plan.
care_options.cautions:
Renal impairment or fluid restriction requires review.
Not a substitute for treatment of infection or obstruction.

care_options.name: Nitrofurantoin option for physician review
care_options.purpose: Treat a selected lower urinary tract infection
care_options.eligibility: Confirm suitability for a lower urinary tract infection and review the culture, care plan, and inventory.
care_options.cautions:
Do not select for kidney infection or suspected prostate involvement.
Unknown or impaired kidney function requires review; do not assume eligibility.
Review allergies, pregnancy, and interactions; be alert to pulmonary and hepatic toxicity.

care_options.name: Physician selection of an antibiotic appropriate to the infection site
care_options.eligibility: After assessment of severity, culture, organ function, and the approved care plan.
care_options.cautions:
No automatic antibiotic selection or substitution.
Infected obstruction may require a specialist procedure, rather than an antibiotic alone.

care_options.name: Anti-inflammatory pain relief option for physician review
care_options.eligibility: When colic is considered likely and individual suitability has been assessed.
care_options.cautions:
Review renal impairment, dehydration, ulcers, bleeding, and pregnancy.
Review NSAID allergy, asthma, anticoagulants, and duplicate NSAID use.
Must not delay urgent assessment.

care_options.name: Tamsulosin option for a selected distal ureteric stone
care_options.purpose: Help passage of a suitable stone
care_options.eligibility: A confirmed distal ureteric stone whose size meets NICE criteria, following physician assessment.
care_options.cautions:
Do not select for every episode of colic or a stone of unknown location; not a substitute for drainage of infected obstruction.
Review low blood pressure, fainting, kidney and liver status, allergies, and interactions.
The physician reviews suitability for conservative management, authorization for the indication, the care plan, and inventory.

care_options.name: Drainage of urinary obstruction by a specialist
care_options.eligibility: Infected obstruction, absence of urine output, or refractory pain assessed by a physician.
care_options.cautions:
A procedure for an authorized specialist using approved equipment; no self-treatment.
Infected obstruction is not treated with an antibiotic alone.

care_options.name: An appropriate fluid plan determined by the physician
care_options.purpose: Avoid dehydration in a stable condition
care_options.eligibility: Able to tolerate drinking, with no fluid restriction.
care_options.cautions:
Do not force drinking when vomiting or unable to urinate.
Assess the kidneys and obstruction first.

care_options.name: Avoid the identified irritant and use gentle care without scratching
care_options.eligibility: After reviewing exposures, without intentional re-exposure.
care_options.cautions:
Do not attribute every rash to allergy.
Emergency signs take priority over topical care.

care_options.name: Unperfumed moisturizer or emollient for physician review
care_options.eligibility: Dry skin after assessment of the condition and selection of a suitable product.
care_options.cautions:
Review product ingredients and allergies.
A blistering rash or painful peeling requires urgent assessment.

care_options.name: Cetirizine option for physician review
care_options.eligibility: Assess the cause, suitability, care plan, and inventory.
care_options.cautions:
Review kidney status, difficulty urinating, epilepsy, and allergies.
May cause drowsiness and affect mission performance; review sedating medications.
Not sufficient treatment for anaphylaxis or a severe skin reaction.

care_options.name: Topical hydrocortisone option for suitable dermatitis
care_options.eligibility: Suitable mild dermatitis assessed by a physician, with selection of the correct product.
care_options.cautions:
No automatic selection for an undiagnosed rash, skin infection, or wound.
The face, area around the eyes, genitals, and sensitive areas require specialist approval.
Review allergies, pregnancy, and damaged skin; do not assume a treatment duration or product strength.

care_options.name: Adjust the sleep environment, schedule, and stimulant use
care_options.purpose: Improve the opportunity for sleep and alertness
care_options.eligibility: A plan suited to the mission schedule and approved by the physician.
care_options.cautions:
Changes to cabin lighting require coordination with environmental controls.
No single amount of sleep applies to everyone.

care_options.name: Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia under specialist supervision
care_options.eligibility: Assessment of insomnia and access to a specialist or approved program.
care_options.cautions:
Assess other sleep disorders first when suspected.
Any behavioral change affecting alertness must align with the mission safety plan.

care_options.name: Review a zolpidem option within an approved medical plan
care_options.purpose: A medication option for selected severe insomnia
care_options.eligibility: A medical decision after assessment of causes and non-drug options, and verification of inventory.
care_options.cautions:
A history of complex sleep behavior with Z-drugs precludes selection under the FDA warning.
Review breathing, sleep apnea, liver status, allergies, and dependence.
Review sedatives, opioids, alcohol, and the risk of impaired performance after sleep.
No automatic initiation, increase, or prescribing, and no invented operational waiting period.

care_options.name: A temporary melatonin option within a circadian timing plan
care_options.eligibility: A timing disturbance reviewed by a physician within an individualized sleep and light plan.
care_options.cautions:
Incorrect timing may worsen misalignment; no automatic timing or dosing.
Evidence from terrestrial travel does not establish suitability for the Martian environment or for every case of insomnia.
Review drowsiness, performance, liver and kidney status, epilepsy, autoimmune disease, pregnancy, and interactions.
A reliable product, verified care plan, and verified inventory are required.

care_options.name: Gentle care, hand hygiene, and avoidance of eye rubbing and contact lenses
care_options.purpose: Reduce irritation and potential transmission of infection
care_options.eligibility: A condition assessed by a physician, without an emergency sign.
care_options.cautions:
Do not share towels or eye drops.
Reduce dust and dry-air exposure in accordance with cabin controls.

care_options.name: Lubricating eye drop option for physician review
care_options.eligibility: After eye assessment and verification of the product and inventory.
care_options.cautions:
Review allergies, preservatives, and product compatibility with contact lenses.
Must not delay assessment of pain or a vision change.
Do not share the bottle.
A documented medication example; its mention does not establish availability or product approval on Mars.

care_options.name: An eye allergy medication option selected by a specialist
care_options.eligibility: After an allergic cause is considered likely and the care plan has been reviewed.
care_options.cautions:
Review allergies, ingredients, and product safety.
No automatic selection based on redness alone.

care_options.name: Review the need for an ophthalmic antibiotic
care_options.purpose: Treat a bacterial cause when indicated
care_options.eligibility: A clinical decision after assessment of the infection site and severity.
care_options.cautions:
Does not help a viral or allergic cause.
Contact lenses, pain, or a vision change requires assessment beyond treatment of simple conjunctivitis.

care_options.name: Rest, appropriate fluids, and review of exposures
care_options.eligibility: A stable condition after assessment for red flags.
care_options.cautions:
Review fluid restrictions and the environmental plan.
Must not delay assessment of deteriorating breathing or a suspected serious cause.

care_options.name: Salbutamol (albuterol) relief option under the astronaut's current plan
care_options.purpose: Relieve symptoms of known airway disease
care_options.eligibility: A reliever prescribed for the astronaut within a current airway disease plan; no automatic replacement of the plan.
care_options.cautions:
No automatic bronchodilator for cough without airway disease, and no substitute for preventive treatment.
Salmeterol is not a rescue medication for a sudden attack and must not be used alone in asthma.
Review allergies, heart status, hyperthyroidism, potassium, diabetes, and inhaler suitability.
Chest pain or worsening breathing afterward requires emergency care; lack of response does not justify automatic repeat use.
Inventory verification and medical authorization are required.

care_options.name: Physician review of the indication for an antibiotic
care_options.purpose: Treat a bacterial infection when indicated
care_options.eligibility: Clinical assessment for bacterial infection or systemic illness/risk of complications.
care_options.cautions:
No routine antibiotic for cough or uncomplicated bronchitis.
Do not infer a bacterial cause from sputum color.
Review allergies, organ function, pregnancy, interactions, and the care plan.

care_options.name: Rest and soft food; fluids only when alert and able to swallow safely.
care_options.eligibility: After physician approval and assessment of warning signs.
care_options.cautions: No oral intake with choking, altered consciousness, or inability to swallow.

care_options.name: Paracetamol selected by the physician for pain relief.
care_options.eligibility: After review of the shared profile, with the product available and an approved plan in place.
care_options.cautions:
Review allergies and liver and kidney function.
Check for the same active ingredient in cold medicines and review medications already administered.

care_options.name: Throat examination and a swab when indicated, performed by qualified staff.
care_options.purpose: Clarify the cause and guide treatment.
care_options.eligibility: By physician decision and when the test can be performed safely.
care_options.cautions:
A swab must not take precedence over airway assessment.
Do not infer a bacterial organism from appearance alone.

care_options.name: Amoxicillin is a reference option for confirmed group A streptococcal pharyngitis; only a physician may select it.
care_options.eligibility: Confirmation by an appropriate rapid test or culture interpreted by the physician, with an individual plan and approved inventory.
care_options.cautions:
No routine antibiotic or automated selection; it does not treat viral pharyngitis.
Review penicillin or drug allergy, kidney function, interactions, and medications already administered.

care_options.name: Paracetamol for pain relief if authorized by the physician.
care_options.eligibility: Within the plan and after review of the profile and product.
care_options.cautions:
Review allergies, liver and kidney function, and duplicate active ingredients.
Pain relief must not delay assessment of sudden hearing loss.

care_options.name: Keep the ear dry and wipe away external discharge only.
care_options.eligibility: Care outside the canal with physician approval.
care_options.cautions: No instruments inside the canal; no routine decongestants or antihistamines.

care_options.name: Assessment for earwax removal by qualified staff after examination of the eardrum.
care_options.eligibility: By clinical decision, with appropriate equipment and training available.
care_options.cautions:
No self-irrigation or self-extraction.
No drops if the eardrum is perforated; an unknown eardrum status requires review.

care_options.name: Selection of cause-directed treatment or ear drops by the physician after examination.
care_options.eligibility: By physician decision based on examination and the profile.
care_options.cautions:
No automatic antibiotic treatment.
Review allergies and the suitability of the drops for the eardrum.

care_options.name: Paracetamol selected by the physician for temporary pain relief.
care_options.purpose: Relieve pain while dental care is being arranged.
care_options.eligibility: After review of the profile, plan, and product.
care_options.cautions:
Review allergies, liver and kidney function, and medications already administered.
Check that the active ingredient is not duplicated; do not delay the dental procedure.

care_options.name: Soft food, gentle cleaning, and avoidance of thermal triggers.
care_options.eligibility: According to physician assessment and with a safe ability to eat and swallow.
care_options.cautions:
These measures do not treat an abscess.
Avoid forcing oral intake when swallowing is unsafe.

care_options.name: A dental procedure determined by the specialist: restoration, pulp or root canal treatment, drainage, or extraction, according to the case.
care_options.purpose: Treat the cause of pain or infection.
care_options.eligibility: Specialist expertise, training, equipment, anesthesia, and an approved clinical plan.
care_options.cautions:
No self-drainage, drilling, or extraction.
The system does not select a procedure without examination.

care_options.name: Review the indication for an antibiotic through a separate medical decision.
care_options.purpose: Treat a selected infection while addressing its source.
care_options.eligibility: Systemic symptoms, or a localized abscess when a procedure is unavailable, may change the physician's decision.
care_options.cautions:
No antibiotic for pulpitis solely because of pain.
An antibiotic does not replace the procedure; review immunodeficiency, allergies, and interactions.

care_options.name: Direct pressure with a clean dressing; press around an embedded object without pressing on it.
care_options.eligibility: After making the scene safe and securing protective measures, in accordance with approved training and an approved plan.
care_options.cautions:
Do not remove an embedded object.
Uncontrolled bleeding is an emergency; advanced procedures are for qualified personnel.

care_options.name: Clean a small wound after controlling the bleeding and cover it with a suitable dressing.
care_options.eligibility: A confirmed superficial wound without an embedded object.
care_options.cautions:
Do not explore deep wounds.
Seek review for increasing pain, redness, or pus.

care_options.name: Assess the need for tetanus vaccine and immunoglobulin, and administer them when indicated by the physician.
care_options.eligibility: According to wound type, immunization record, immune status, and inventory; administration is by qualified staff.
care_options.cautions:
Do not assume that immunization is complete when the record is missing.
Antibiotics do not provide tetanus prophylaxis.

care_options.name: Medical cleaning, removal of damaged tissue, or appropriate closure by specialist decision.
care_options.eligibility: Qualified staff, equipment, and a plan; assess infection before closure.
care_options.cautions:
No self-suturing or self-debridement.
The physician decides on antibiotics for infection; they are not automatic for every wound.

care_options.name: After safely stopping the exposure, cool the thermal burn site under cool running water for 20 minutes.
care_options.eligibility: An approved plan and safe cooling; the stated time applies only to thermal burns.
care_options.cautions:
No ice; protect the rest of the body from hypothermia.
Do not delay emergency response or generalize this to an unknown chemical.

care_options.name: A clean, non-adherent covering after appropriate first aid.
care_options.eligibility: After securing the source and assessing the exposure; without tight bandaging.
care_options.cautions:
Do not remove stuck material or burst blisters.
No oils, pastes, or household substances.

care_options.name: Paracetamol if selected by the physician for pain relief.
care_options.eligibility: After review of the profile and product; with safe swallowing if given orally.
care_options.cautions:
Review allergies, liver and kidney function, and duplicate active ingredients.
Pain relief must not delay assessment of a deep burn.

care_options.name: Assessment and treatment of the burn and chemical decontamination appropriate to the substance, performed by a specialist.
care_options.purpose: Determine severity and treat the injury.
care_options.eligibility: Qualified staff, equipment, protection, and an exposure-specific plan.
care_options.cautions:
Electrical exposure requires securing the source before contact.
No automatic antibiotics or surgical procedure; review tetanus prevention when needed.

care_options.name: Stop exertion, move the affected person to a safe, cool location, remove excess clothing, and cool the skin.
care_options.eligibility: With a trained companion and an environmental and equipment safety plan; call for emergency response if consciousness changes.
care_options.cautions:
Do not delay requesting help in order to take measurements.
Do not remove essential protective equipment before making the environment safe.

care_options.name: Sips of potable fluid or a rehydration solution selected by the physician.
care_options.purpose: Appropriate replacement of fluid and salt losses.
care_options.eligibility: Only if the affected person is fully alert, can swallow safely, and has no shock, confusion, or active vomiting.
care_options.cautions:
Nothing by mouth with unsafe swallowing or altered consciousness.
Review fluid restrictions and kidney and heart status; no salt tablets or improvised mixtures.

care_options.name: Active cooling and urgent medical monitoring for suspected heatstroke.
care_options.purpose: Lower temperature and support vital functions.
care_options.eligibility: By qualified staff with airway protection and appropriate monitoring.
care_options.cautions:
Heatstroke is an emergency even when sweating is present.
Immersion or advanced procedures are not unmonitored self-treatment.

care_options.name: Assessment of the need for intravenous fluids and electrolyte and kidney tests by physician decision.
care_options.purpose: Treat complicated dehydration and assess organ injury.
care_options.eligibility: Qualified staff, an individual plan, and equipment; particularly when oral rehydration is not possible.
care_options.cautions:
No self-cannulation or self-infusion.
Review heart or kidney disease and the risk of fluid overload; no automatically determined volume.
